title: Avtryck: Graduation Identity
descriptionEnglish:
The graduating show is a place to make a mark (avtryck), a chance to take place and position one self for the future with competence and self-assertion. We have made the choice to portray this year's theme with a seal as a stamp of quality and with a signet ring as a symbol for belonging and community: We are the graduating bachelor class at Beckmans College of Design 2026. The seal is a ceremonial and bold/daring way to make one's mark with and is the soul of the graduating show’s campaign. 

The campaign was created together with Linn Sehlstedt and Phoebe Crookes.

title: Process, Material, Craft
descriptionEnglish:
Process, Material, Craft - studies in furniture, interior and objects, a three-part exhibition with Beckmans, Konstfack and Malmstens at Moderna Dansteatern. Posters, signage, catalogue, invitation and social media. 

Created together with Edda Eliasson, Mika Hyvönen,
and Olle Svensson 

Photographer: Madeleine Sjöberg

Documentation: Jesper Smeding.

title: NewPlatforms.txt, Re:action Workshop and Re:action Exhibition
descriptionEnglish:
“The current state of established digital platforms and its influence on visual communication is under scrutiny by us students, teachers and human beings. Because frankly, we’re disappointed with the current state of affairs.” 

Three parts created for New Platforms, an design festival at Beckmans Collage of Design. 
NewPlatforms.txt is a publication made to broaden the subject of alternative and new possible platforms. We learn more about this subject through invited writers, who each bring an interesting point of view. Re:action Workshop is a workshop presented as an analogue internet platform. Where you can playfully engage, create and react to your surroundings. Re:action Exhibition is the result of a workshop our class completed together. We wanted to show our collective creativity and reduce the pressure of performance. To achieve less pressure and a unified expression, we wanted to use limited tools and shapes. From these thoughts came the idea of Re:action Workshop.

Created together with Phoebe Crookes and Hanna Hedberg

Documentation: Jonas Hermlin

title: What Happens In the Arctic Does Not Stay In the Arctic
descriptionEnglish:
What's happening in the Arctic right now is part of a larger, circular context. The consequences of our actions, in turn, circle back to us. Through nature's cycles, our impact, and the polar circle that surrounds the Arctic, we highlight how everything is connected and how nothing exists in isolation. The rapid climate changes are forcing people in the Arctic to adapt in order to preserve their communities – something we all must do. With this exhibition, we visualise how different parts of the Arctic are affected by climate change – and why it matters to all of us.

What Happens In the Arctic Does Not Stay In the Arctic consists of seven interpretations of Arctic research, developed in dialogue between students at Beckmans College of Design and researchers from the Beijer Institute, in collaboration with Svenskt Tenn.
